description: A dark workshop scene. A wooden frame holds two copper-wire coil spools at the top and a large dark horseshoe magnet in the middle. A metal shaft with a crank handle runs down the centre, and a weathered hand grips the crank on the right. Copper wires hang from the coils. A small electric spark glows at a copper commutator at the base. Jars, tools and metal scraps are scattered in the shadowy background, and the painting fills the whole image edge to edge.
